case.title: The Safe House Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the ruin of the big event of the evening has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The ruin of the big event of the evening
case.target_fake_identity: Olivia Holloway, a news reporter people trust
case.escape_plan: Olivia Holloway plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the ruin of the big event of the evening.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Olivia Holloway is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

evidence.name: a page from an account book
evidence.description: A page of numbers that do not add up.

hidden_clues: Olivia Holloway's story about where they were does not match the a wine glass.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a news reporter
solution.reasoning: Olivia Holloway is the hidden person. The main clues (a wine glass, a fake passport) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: 6 guests. One fake identity. It happened at The Ashgrove Safe House. Find the clue that breaks their alibi and name the person behind the ruin of the big event of the evening. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.

exchanges.answer: Like I said before, I saw something odd that night.
